topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic, contextualizes its complexity, and sets expectations for the session.

topics.label: Overview and core mechanics of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts, naming conventions, and central role of C3 cleavage in the complement system.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three recognition pathways that generate convertases and drive complement deposition to the activation threshold.

topics.label: Effector functions of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how activated complement clears pathogens through opsonization, inflammatory signaling, and membrane lysis.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that protect host cells from accidental complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the distinct clinical presentations and disease susceptibilities caused by deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the evolutionary strategies microbes use to avoid complement destruction, focusing on mechanisms in Staphylococcus aureus.

topics.label: Lecture closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the subject of the upcoming lecture.
